purpose: Register nine already-local PDF files from bounded 578 nm benchmark searches and Offer convention audits; no canonical parameter, production formula or main diagram changes.
policy: All sources are supplemental evidence. Paper identity, available original bytes, parameter applicability and independent experimental validation are separate states. No full-text content is redistributed in this registry.
historicalProvenanceBoundary: New source support and canonical aliases do not rewrite historical audit source IDs, source snapshots or the generating provenance of internal atomic records.

sources.title: R. F. Offer et al.
sources.detail: Portable laser-cooled ytterbium beam clock based on an ultra-narrow optical transition
sources.referenceRole: Supplemental 578 nm conditional power/coupling comparison and model-convention audit; stage-available power and fitted effective power remain distinct
evidenceNotes: 338mW is a fit parameter, not an independent measured input. A contrast-derived coupling can be eligible in principle, but 1070mW is stage-available power and the exact waist/channel/interaction-power mapping remains incomplete. Feeding 338mW back into the same scalar-coupling model is circular.
1mm diameter explicitly mapped to Gaussian 1/e^2 intensity diameter at the interaction region
numerical power at each interaction location / optical transmission and mode overlap
addressed q components and dipole/saturation-intensity convention
independent power/waist and fitted-coupling uncertainties
